title: About us
summary: Three generations of engineers, one workshop, and a stubborn refusal to move production offshore.
body: Northwind was started by Alan Whitfield in 1974 with two lathes and one customer. His granddaughter runs the calibration laboratory. Forty-one people work here and most of them have been here more than a decade, which is unusual and is the reason the instruments are what they are.
author: dana okoro
